svg.title: Eclipse webOS app tile
svg.desc: Full-bleed webOS tile ("E1", chosen by the user 2026-10-04 from in-photo mockups): the tile itself is the split screen -- the Eclipse/Umbra mark's two violet panels (site/assets/brand-mark.svg colours, with a light top-to-bottom gradient) filling the whole tile, and the white seam between them. Like LG's own tiles the art fills the space; the launcher clips the corners. appinfo iconColor = the left panel violet.
